schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

floor_id.description: The floor id `map.json` states, on the floor frame. One export is one floor.

vda5050_reference_barcode.description: The barcode of the one cell `map.json` offers as a vendor-frame sample point. SPEC §4 names a sample point in place of a transform as the anti-pattern; the transform is declared on the vendor frame instead, and this is the sample the export stated. Its other half — the vendor coordinate — is that cell's own field, so the export rebuilds the pair from the cell.
